Chapter 6569: What’S Hidden?

Chapter 6569: What’s Hidden?

“Shouldn’t he be called Zhan Shisheng instead?” Another overlord said. [1]

Zhan Sansheng’s feat was miraculous. He repeated something three times while others had no chance.

Now, everyone understood Desolate Ancestor’s decision to attack the portal. The forest couldn’t hinder her pace. However, it did block everyone’s vision.

Nevertheless, they sensed her permeating saber intent and determination.

“Buzz.” Something flashed within the forest. Perhaps it was Zhan Sansheng being forced to show himself and fleeing further.

A corner of something was revealed during the escape. Time came to a stop and the area seemingly transported to a different realm.

“Rumble!” Suddenly, tribulations appeared above everyone and descended, eradicating all living beings before they could react.

Fortunately, this was only an illusion due to the emergence of the unknown thing. Nevertheless, everyone got a taste of death.

“What was that?” No one had an idea what it was.

“Boom!” Immortal beams suddenly rushed out of two redemption grounds, heading through Primordial Gate.

“Fiendish Ground and Evil Transformation!” Everyone became alarmed.

Six redemption grounds existed in Three Immortals. Three belonged to Xian Chengtian’s masters who disappeared after losing in Heavenslay. The fourth, Heavenly Sin, fell in battle.

Thus, only Fiendish Ground and Evil Transformation remained. They became reclusive after Heavenslay until today.

“Are they working with Zhan Sansheng to kill Desolate Ancestor?” Powerful spectators became terrified. The odds would be against her then.

Many worried but couldn’t do anything to help. This was a fight between immortals; even overlords would find themselves useless.

However, once the two immortal beams entered the primordial forest, they pulsed in and out of existence. Loud buzzes could be heard - the sound of imprinting.

On the other hand, Desolate Ancestor pressed forward in another direction.

“What’s going on?” Many became confused since the beams appeared to be searching for something.

“What was that thing earlier?” A supreme overlord understood the core of the issue.

“Clank!” The blade slashed the primordial forest and broke through a seal, leaving a hole.

Everyone could tell that slash alone was enough to remove Three Immortals from existence.

“We’re lucky that this isn’t happening in our world.” An emperor said.

That slash earlier was more dreadful than the one used to kill Bao Pu.

A meteor rushed out of the hole and flew through Primordial Gate, folding space along the way and creating stars and galaxies.

Everything came to a stop as if a supreme hand was grasping them. The meteor entered Heaven World, ending the visual phenomena behind.

“Rumble!” The folded space collapsed and the stars exploded, causing Primordial Gate to close.

While within Heaven World, the meteor fell toward a peerless city. Wondrous images of immortals and heavenly azures emerged as the city barriers, preventing devastating damage. The meteor disappeared afterward.

“That place, Terra City?” Someone reacted and murmured.

Many things happened all at once and cultivators had no good prediction. Moreover, the gate was closed now so they couldn’t observe the situation.

“Haha, you hid a lot in there.” The skull told Li Qiye.

“Not at all, it’s just that everyone wants to go inside. It’s not my business.” Li Qiye shook his head.

1. San is three, Shi is four ☜
